summary: Verified Coordinatore role fix on preview URL. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass — coord.test@registrateam.it can login, /auth/me returns all 9 coordinator_permissions (teams, athletes, trainings, matches, attendance, communications, events, certificates, gdpr_view), and every dashboard-backing endpoint returns 200 (no 403): /api/athletes (non-empty), /api/matches, /api/teams (non-empty), /api/teams/athletes-count/all, /api/attendance/today, /api/admin/notifications, /api/preseason/campaigns, /api/admin/medical-certificates-archive, /api/documents/archive. Frontend: 9/9 dashboard section cards navigate to the correct /admin/* screen — NO card redirects to /login and NO card lands on an 'Unmatched Route' page. Data actually renders (e.g. Atleti (3), 2 teams, 4 medical certificates, 112 GDPR documents, 21 preseason responses).

ui_bugs.issue: TouchableOpacity cards use `data-testid` as JSX prop but React Native Web's TouchableOpacity does NOT forward this to the DOM (only 3 real data-testid attributes exist on the page: guide-button-coordinatore, guide-hint-backdrop, guide-hint-ok). Use `testID` prop instead so automated tests can target the cards reliably.

issues: Both Serie C and Serie D show '0 atleti' even though /admin/athletes lists 3 athletes and /api/teams/athletes-count/all returned 200. Not a blocker for this task but the count-per-team endpoint result may be filtered/empty for coordinator; verify per-team counts propagate.

action_items: (Optional) Replace `data-testid="coord-section-..."` on TouchableOpacity with `testID="coord-section-..."` in /app/frontend/app/coordinatore/index.tsx so RN-Web renders the attribute and automated tests can select cards.

(Optional) Investigate why /admin/teams renders '0 atleti' per team for the coordinator while /admin/athletes correctly shows 3 athletes — likely the per-team counter endpoint returns empty or the client-side filter needs coordinator role parity.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout still declares Screen children that do not exist: 'preseason', 'admin/whatsapp-reminders', 'admin/whatsapp-settings' — Expo Router prints warnings on every navigation. Non-blocking but noisy.

Multiple 403s in the browser console during admin page loads (compensi/IBAN/sponsor-style endpoints) — expected per design because admin-only endpoints must remain protected; no code change needed but consider suppressing calls when role=coordinatore to reduce console noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coordinator credentials coord.test@registrateam.it / Test1234 (society 697fdba0d218717959e73eea, all 9 coordinator_permissions). Login via POST /api/auth/login only returns basic user; the coordinator_permissions come from /api/auth/me — the frontend authStore fetches it on load. When testing coord dashboard cards via Playwright, prefer page.get_by_text(label, exact=True) because RN-Web's TouchableOpacity does NOT propagate `data-testid` from JSX (only pure View does). Dismiss 'Ho capito' (guide hint) and 'Solo necessari' (cookie banner) modals before interacting.
rca_of_issue: The three original symptoms are all fixed on preview: (1) 'Unmatched Route' cards — the SECTIONS array in /app/frontend/app/coordinatore/index.tsx now targets 9 real admin screens (all resolve, no blank page). (2) Redirect to /login — /app/frontend/app/admin/_layout.tsx now accepts role=coordinatore and its COORDINATOR_ALLOWED_PATHS whitelist includes every destination (teams, athletes, attendances, matches, notifications, preseason, medical-certificates-archive, documents-archive). (3) Empty lists due to 403 — the backend endpoints /athletes, /matches, /teams, /teams/athletes-count/all, /attendance/today, /admin/notifications, /preseason/campaigns, /admin/medical-certificates-archive, /documents/archive all now return 200 for the coordinator token (verified end-to-end).
